title: The Regiment of Vilna
author: Casper Yarrow
blurb: Rosalind Amberdale, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
